meta.title: Join the league
meta.description: How to join FGV Quant, FGV-SP's Quantitative Finance League.

intro.title: Recruitment process
intro.description: FGV Quant brings together FGV-SP students who want to learn quantitative finance by doing. Details of the next recruitment process haven't been announced yet. This page will be updated as soon as they are.

how.title: How it works
how.description: Stages, deadlines and criteria will be published here once the league announces the process.

who.title: Who can take part
who.body: The league is for FGV-SP students interested in quantitative finance.

build.title: What you will learn
build.description: Trainees go through a training program with in-person and online classes, assessments and a final project, covering the foundations of quantitative finance.

descriptions.statistics: Probability and inference as the basis for analyzing financial data.
descriptions.econometrics: Models to estimate relationships and test hypotheses with market data.
descriptions.strategies: How systematic strategies are built and evaluated.
descriptions.portfolios: Building portfolios and balancing risk and return.
descriptions.fixedIncome: Bonds, interest rates and the term structure.
descriptions.derivatives: Options, futures and how to price them.

classes.title: Classes
classes.body: In-person and online sessions, one topic per class.

assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.body: Problem sets and exams to consolidate the material.

project.title: Final project
project.body: Built throughout the program, with partial deliveries and a presentation at the end.

items.a: No date has been announced yet. Once the league announces it, we'll publish it here and on our channels.
The league is for FGV-SP students. Eligibility requirements will be published together with the process details.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. The recruitment process has no technical prerequisites.

items.q: How will I know when applications open?
items.a: Follow FGV Quant on Instagram and LinkedIn: that's where announcements will be posted.

notify.title: Get notified when it opens
notify.description: Follow the league to find out when the recruitment process is announced.
